name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-alcazar-castle-maze
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Alcazar Castle (Maze)
description:
One of the backgrounds seen in Argazarl Castle, from the obscure japanese port of Popful Mail from Super Famicom. It appears in what appears to be a maze section of the castle. Uses 14 tiles, which makes this background very easy to use with a lot of decorations. It is easy to expand it vertically.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
